title: Matrix Context: A Local-First, Inspectable Mixture-of-Contexts Layer for Agent Memory
description: Matrix Context routes each query to a small subset of typed context experts, retrieves with hybrid lexical and dense fusion, and assembles a token-budgeted, explainable context pack scored by relevance, importance, recency, and a redundancy penalty. Ships a Python SDK, CLI, a minimal v1 REST surface (explainable /v1/inspect), framework adapters (agent-generator, HomePilot), and the MoC-RAG Benchmark — a reproducible robustness suite showing that routed typed context is markedly more robust than flat RAG when lexical matching is unreliable.
